Question on § “Physical and chemical phenomena” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Formulation: What characteristic refers to the concept of “physical phenomena”?

Correct answer: Phenomena when the state of aggregation of substances changes without the formation of new substances.

Physical phenomena - when the state of aggregation changes.

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. Phenomena that usually occur only when the aggregate state of substances changes are called physical phenomena.

2. Phenomena in which new substances are formed from these substances are called chemical phenomena.

3. Signs of chemical phenomena: gas discharge; precipitation; color change; release of odor, etc.

4. Phenomena in which new substances are formed from given substances are called chemical phenomena.

1. Odatda moddalarning agregat holati o'zgargandagina sodir bo'ladigan hodisalar fizik hodisalar deyiladi.

3. Kimyoviy hodisalarning belgilari: gaz ajralishi; yog'ingarchilik; rang o'zgarishi; hidning chiqishi va boshqalar.

4. Berilgan moddalardan yangi moddalar hosil bo`ladigan hodisalar kimyoviy hodisalar deyiladi.

g7-c3-s02-q01.explanationEn: Periods are horizontal series of PS.
g7-c3-s02-q01.descriptionEn:
Question on § “Natural families of chemical elements” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Formulation: What characteristic refers to the concept of “period in the periodic table”?

Correct answer: Horizontal row of elements.

Periods are horizontal series of PS.

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. These are lithium Li, sodium Na, potassium K, rubidium Rb, cesium Cs, francium Fr.

2. They are called alkali metals, since when they interact with water they form alkali bases that are highly soluble in water.

3. They react violently with water and exhibit valency I in the compounds.

4. The metallic activity of alkali metals in a group increases from top to bottom.

Remember: the answer must match the wording of the textbook. After choosing an option, check yourself again using the text §.
g7-c3-s02-q01.descriptionUz:
§ “Kimyoviy elementlarning tabiiy oilalari” bo‘yicha savol (Kimyo, 7-sinf).

Formulyatsiya: "Davriy jadvaldagi davr" tushunchasiga qanday xususiyat tegishli?

To'g'ri javob: Elementlarning gorizontal qatori.

Davrlar PS ning gorizontal qatoridir.

Paragraf materiali (javobni qo'llab-quvvatlash):

1. Bular litiy Li, natriy Na, kaliy K, rubidiy Rb, seziy Cs, fransiy Fr.

2. Ular gidroksidi metallar deyiladi, chunki ular suv bilan o'zaro ta'sirlashganda suvda yaxshi eriydigan ishqoriy asoslarni hosil qiladi.

3. Ular suv bilan kuchli reaksiyaga kirishib, birikmalarda I valentlikni namoyon qiladi.

4. Guruhdagi ishqoriy metallarning metall faolligi yuqoridan pastgacha ortadi.

Esingizda bo'lsin: javob darslik matniga mos kelishi kerak. Variantni tanlagandan so'ng, § matni yordamida o'zingizni yana tekshiring.

g7-c7-s05-q04.descriptionEn:
Question on § “Determination of the composition of an apple” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Formulation: Which conclusion on the topic “Determination of the composition of an apple” can be considered correct?

Correct answer: An electrically neutral particle consisting of a nucleus and electrons.

An atom is electrically neutral: nucleus (+) and electrons (−).

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. Almost all researchers admit that apples are one of the healthiest fruits.

2. Although the apple does not hold the record for nutritional value, it is considered the most delicious and healthy fruit on earth.

3. Rejuvenates the body and strengthens the immune system.

4. Iron contained in apples is very useful in treating anemia.

Remember: the answer must match the wording of the textbook. After choosing an option, check yourself again using the text §.

To'g'ri javob: Yadro va elektronlardan tashkil topgan elektr neytral zarracha.

Atom elektr jihatdan neytraldir: yadro (+) va elektronlar (-).

1. Deyarli barcha tadqiqotchilar olma eng foydali mevalardan biri ekanligini tan olishadi.

3. Organizmni yoshartiradi va immunitetni mustahkamlaydi.

4. Olma tarkibidagi temir kamqonlikni davolashda juda foydali.

Esingizda bo'lsin: javob darslik matniga mos kelishi kerak. Variantni tanlagandan so'ng, § matni yordamida o'zingizni yana tekshiring.
